lines.zh: 我摆尾向前，水草从我身侧滑过。
lines.en: I flick my tail forward, and weeds slide past my flanks.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床游，肚皮擦过细沙。
lines.en: I swim along the riverbed, belly brushing fine sand.

lines.zh: 一群同类挤在一起，水都被搅浑了。
lines.en: My school crowds so tight the water turns cloudy.

lines.zh: 我转弯很快，鳍一收就换方向。
lines.en: I turn sharply; one fold of the fin changes direction.

lines.zh: 逆流时我贴着石头走，省力气。
lines.en: Against the current I hug the stones to save strength.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但从不直着走。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never swim straight.

lines.zh: 水面的光落下来，在我背上碎成几片。
lines.en: Surface light falls and breaks across my back.

lines.zh: 我忽然一窜，只因为后面有影子。
lines.en: I dart suddenly, only because a shadow is behind me.

lines.zh: 我的鳞很小，游动时几乎不反光。
lines.en: My scales are tiny and barely shine as I swim.

lines.zh: 河道拐弯的地方，我知道怎么抄近路。
lines.en: At the river bend, I know the shortcut.

lines.zh: 我穿过桥墩的缝隙，那是我常走的路。
lines.en: I slip between the bridge piers, my usual route.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我搅起来，正好遮住我。
lines.en: I stir up bottom mud, which hides me nicely.

lines.zh: 我跟着一片落叶游了很久。
lines.en: I followed a fallen leaf for a long while.

lines.zh: 我摆尾的动作很轻，怕惊动更大的鱼。
lines.en: My tail beats softly, lest I wake bigger fish.

lines.zh: 我从石头下游过去，没碰到它。
lines.en: I slip under the stone without touching it.

lines.zh: 水一凉，我就往深处挪。
lines.en: The water cools, so I move deeper.

lines.zh: 我悬在水草间，让水流替我晃。
lines.en: I hang among the weeds and let the current sway me.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴等食物漂进来，很省事。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open for food to drift in; efficient.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我的鳃一张一合。
lines.en: The water is cold; my gills open and close.

lines.zh: 上面有影子晃过，我沉低了一点。
lines.en: A shadow passes above, and I sink a little lower.

lines.zh: 我盯着一个气泡，看它一直升到水面。
lines.en: I watch a bubble rise all the way to the surface.

lines.zh: 河底的石头我数过很多遍。
lines.en: I have counted the stones on the riverbed many times.

lines.zh: 水里才是我的地方，上岸就完了。
lines.en: Water is my place. Ashore I'm finished.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼经过，我懒得追。
lines.en: A school of small fish passes, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把鳍张开，像一片薄薄的水草。
lines.en: I spread my fins like a thin blade of weed.

lines.zh: 水面结了一层光，我看不清岸上。
lines.en: Light films the surface, and I cannot see the bank.

lines.zh: 我保持不动，这样最不显眼。
lines.en: I stay motionless; that is the least conspicuous.

lines.zh: 有东西在敲木头，声音闷闷的。
lines.en: Something knocks on wood, a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻摆着，只是为了不沉下去。
lines.en: My tail sways lightly, only to keep from sinking.

lines.zh: 水底的泥很软，我贴着它休息。
lines.en: The bottom mud is soft, and I rest against it.

lines.zh: 你蹲在岸边，脸被水光晃得模糊。
lines.en: You crouch on the bank, your face blurred by ripples.

lines.zh: 你在看我，我在看你的倒影。
lines.en: You watch me; I watch your reflection.

lines.zh: 你的手伸进水里，我立刻退开。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water, and I withdraw at once.

lines.zh: 我隔着水面看你，你比我大太多了。
lines.en: I see you through the surface; you are far too big.

lines.zh: 你的影子压下来，我往草里钻。
lines.en: Your shadow falls, and I burrow into the weeds.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底看你，鳞片都绷紧了。
lines.en: I watch you from the riverbed, every scale taut.

lines.zh: 你在水边站了很久，我也看了很久。
lines.en: You stood there long, and I watched just as long.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声从岸上传下来，很重。
lines.en: Your footsteps come down through the bank, heavy.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，把尾巴对着你。
lines.en: I turn and point my tail at you.

lines.zh: 你靠近时水纹变了，我知道你在哪。
lines.en: The ripples change as you near; I know where you are.

lines.zh: 我只有两颗心的血，一击就见底。
lines.en: I have only two hearts of blood; one hit shows the bottom.

lines.zh: 我猛地一窜，水花溅得老高。
lines.en: I bolt, throwing up a tall splash.

lines.zh: 疼得我鳞片都竖起来了。
lines.en: The pain makes my scales stand on end.

lines.zh: 我不打了，逃命要紧。
lines.en: I am done fighting; fleeing matters more.

lines.zh: 你打偏了，我钻进了石头缝。
lines.en: You missed, and I slipped into a crack.

lines.zh: 这一下让我少了一片鳍。
lines.en: That cost me a piece of fin.

lines.zh: 我在水里打转，找最近的藏身处。
lines.en: I spin in the water, seeking the nearest cover.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像一团红雾。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water like red mist.

lines.zh: 我拼命摆尾，只想离你远一点。
lines.en: I thrash my tail, wanting only distance from you.

lines.zh: 别追了，我游不过你，但能躲。
lines.en: Stop chasing; I cannot outswim you, but I can hide.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎屑，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the crumbs you scattered.

lines.zh: 我绕了一圈，先看有没有钩子。
lines.en: I circle once, checking for a hook.

lines.zh: 那东西浮在水面，我不敢直接咬。
lines.en: It floats on the surface; I dare not bite directly.

lines.zh: 同伴先冲上去了，我跟着也冲。
lines.en: A schoolmate darts first, and I follow.

lines.zh: 鱼食一落水，我的牙先碰到。
lines.en: The moment fish food hits the water, my teeth find it first.

lines.zh: 食物和危险常常一起出现。
lines.en: Food and danger usually arrive together.

lines.zh: 我试探着碰了一下，然后退开。
lines.en: I nudge it once, then back away.

lines.zh: 水面上那点颜色，比水草好看。
lines.en: That bit of color on the surface beats the weeds.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但还没饿到不顾一切。
lines.en: I am hungry, but not yet reckless.

lines.zh: 你手一抖，我就不敢再靠近。
lines.en: When your hand twitches, I come no closer.

lines.zh: 你踩进水里，把我撞得翻了个身。
lines.en: You step into the water and flip me over.

lines.zh: 我的身体很滑，你抓不住。
lines.en: My body is slippery; you cannot hold me.

lines.zh: 我撞在你的靴子上，弹回水草里。
lines.en: I hit your boot and bounce back into the weeds.

lines.zh: 水面被搅乱，我一时找不到方向。
lines.en: The surface churns, and I lose my bearings.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一段水草，我的藏身处没了。
lines.en: You crush a clump of weeds, and my cover is gone.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的小腿游过，你没察觉。
lines.en: I slip past your calf, and you never notice.

lines.zh: 我撞到石头，鳞片掉了一小片。
lines.en: I hit a stone and lose a small scale.

lines.zh: 你动作太大，整条河都在晃。
lines.en: Your movement shakes the whole river.

lines.zh: 我退到深处，等水面重新静下来。
lines.en: I retreat deep and wait for the surface to still.

lines.zh: 这一下把我吓得钻进泥里。
lines.en: That frightens me into the mud.

lines.zh: 挤在一起游才安心。
lines.en: Swimming packed together feels safe.

lines.zh: 产卵要在浅水的水草里，那里安全。
lines.en: Eggs must go among the shallow weeds, where it is safe.

lines.zh: 他绕着我转圈，鳞片闪了一下。
lines.en: He circles me, and his scales flash once.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，像一小片会动的水草。
lines.en: We press together like a moving patch of weed.

lines.zh: 这个季节河水暖，正好。
lines.en: The river is warm this season, which suits us.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰他的鳍，这就够了。
lines.en: I touch his fin with my mouth; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我们守着卵，谁靠近就撞谁。
lines.en: We guard the eggs and ram anything that comes near.

lines.zh: 鱼群把我们围在中间，像一堵墙。
lines.en: The school surrounds us like a wall.

lines.zh: 他不算好看，但游得很稳。
lines.en: He is not handsome, but he swims steadily.

lines.zh: 水一浑，我们就谁也看不见谁了。
lines.en: When the water clouds, we lose sight of each other.

lines.zh: 我张嘴一吸，碎屑就进了肚子。
lines.en: I open my mouth and suck the crumbs in.

lines.zh: 太重的东西我拖不动，只能看着。
lines.en: Things too heavy to drag, I can only watch.

lines.zh: 我用嘴顶了顶，它滚进石头缝里。
lines.en: I nudge it, and it rolls into a stone crack.

lines.zh: 捡东西不划算，容易被人看见。
lines.en: Picking things up is a bad trade; it draws eyes.

lines.zh: 那东西沉下去，我追了两下就放弃。
lines.en: It sinks, and after two darts I give up.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口，发现是硬壳的。
lines.en: I bite once and find it hard-shelled.

lines.zh: 嘴太小，这堆东西拖不动。
lines.en: My mouth is too small to drag this pile.

lines.zh: 水底的东西归我，岸上的归你。
lines.en: Things on the bottom are mine; things on the bank, yours.

lines.zh: 我吞得太急，鳃都鼓起来了。
lines.en: I swallow too fast, and my gills bulge.

lines.zh: 它卡在我牙缝里，很难受。
lines.en: It wedges between my teeth, unpleasant.

lines.zh: 我很少追人，除非你踩进我的水。
lines.en: I rarely chase, unless you step into my water.

lines.zh: 你搅浑了河底，我记住了你。
lines.en: You muddied the riverbed; I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我不主动，但你挡住了我的路。
lines.en: I do not start fights, but you block my way.

lines.zh: 要咬也不是现在，得等你靠近。
lines.en: If I bite, not yet; wait until you come near.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那里没有鳞。
lines.en: I fix on your ankle; it has no scales.

lines.zh: 你退后了，我也不会追上去。
lines.en: You retreat, and I will not follow.

lines.zh: 水草在动，我借着它靠近。
lines.en: The weeds move, and I use them to approach.

lines.zh: 你拍水的声音太吵，我不得不防。
lines.en: Your splashing is loud, and I must be wary.

lines.zh: 这条河是我的地盘，你只是过客。
lines.en: This river is mine; you are only passing through.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，从水面下。
lines.en: I circle behind you, under the surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床靠近，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed and approach as quietly as I can.

lines.zh: 你的脚还在水里，机会刚好。
lines.en: Your foot is still in the water; the chance is good.

lines.zh: 水纹把你的位置告诉我了。
lines.en: The ripples tell me where you are.

lines.zh: 我把身体绷紧，像一张拉满的弓。
lines.en: I tense my body like a drawn bow.

lines.zh: 等你弯腰，我就冲你的手指去。
lines.en: When you bend down, I will go for your fingers.

lines.zh: 我在水草后面等，耐心很好。
lines.en: I wait behind the weeds, and I am patient.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在水底，正好是靶子。
lines.en: Your shadow on the bottom makes a fine target.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，牙齿很小但很密。
lines.en: My mouth is open; my teeth are small but many.

lines.zh: 你一动，我就知道该往哪边闪。
lines.en: The moment you move, I know which way to dart.

lines.zh: 这条路我游过一千次，闭着眼也熟。
lines.en: I have swum this route a thousand times blind.

lines.zh: 我一口咬在你脚踝上，然后立刻松口。
lines.en: I bite your ankle once and release at once.

lines.zh: 我的牙不大，但咬住就不放。
lines.en: My teeth are small, but once they catch, they hold.

lines.zh: 我撞你的小腿，只是让你退一步。
lines.en: I ram your calf, only to make you step back.

lines.zh: 你踢过来，我翻身躲进水草。
lines.en: You kick, and I roll into the weeds.

lines.zh: 水面炸开，我咬了一口就跑。
lines.en: The surface bursts; I bite once and flee.

lines.zh: 我撕下一小块，然后游得飞快。
lines.en: I tear off a small piece and swim off fast.

lines.zh: 我的攻击不重，疼是会疼的。
lines.en: My bite is not heavy, but it does sting.

lines.zh: 你流血了，水里的味道一下子浓了。
lines.en: You bleed, and the water suddenly tastes strong.

lines.zh: 我不恋战，咬完就躲进石头缝。
lines.en: I do not linger; I bite and hide in a crack.

lines.zh: 这一口只是想让你记住我。
lines.en: This bite is only to make you remember me.

lines.zh: 一枚卵在水草里晃了晃，我钻了出来。
lines.en: An egg sways in the weeds, and I wriggle out.

lines.zh: 我刚出生，只有一粒米那么大。
lines.en: Newly born, I am no bigger than a grain of rice.

lines.zh: 水草替我挡了一会儿水流。
lines.en: The weeds sheltered me from the current a while.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找同伴，找到了就安心。
lines.en: My first act is to find my school; finding it calms me.

lines.zh: 河水的味道，从我睁眼起就记住了。
lines.en: I have known the taste of this river since I opened my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从卵壳里挣出来，尾巴先动。
lines.en: I struggle out of the shell, tail first.

lines.zh: 一群同类围过来，把我挤在中间。
lines.en: The school closes around me and squeezes me into the middle.

lines.zh: 我太小，连水蚤都比我大。
lines.en: I am so small that even water fleas outweigh me.

lines.zh: 这条河又添了一条没人会注意的小鱼。
lines.en: The river gains one more fish no one will notice.

lines.zh: 我摆了两下尾，就游进了水草深处。
lines.en: Two flicks of my tail, and I vanish into the weeds.

lines.zh: 热水追着我，我只会往下躲。
lines.en: The heat chases me. I can only dive.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，扑腾着找水。
lines.en: I am flung onto the bank and flop toward water.

lines.zh: 鱼也会淹死？水里的空气不够了。
lines.en: Can a fish drown? The water holds no air.

lines.zh: 冲击把整条河掀了起来，我翻着肚子。
lines.en: The blast lifts the whole river, and I turn belly-up.

lines.zh: 那支箭穿过水面，擦掉我半边鳞。
lines.en: The arrow pierces the surface and scrapes off half my scales.

lines.zh: 魔法在水里变成了紫色，我扭头就跑。
lines.en: The spell turns purple in the water, and I turn and flee.

lines.zh: 水草都啃光了，我还是饿。
lines.en: I have gnawed all the weeds and am still hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打进河里，我整条鱼都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning enters the river, and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的鳃拼命张着。
lines.en: There is no water in the void, and my gills gape.
